Crafting the Future at the
Intersection of Cloud & AI

I am a Computer Science Engineering student at Lovely Professional University with a deep passion for building scalable, intelligent systems. My work lives at the intersection of Cloud Native engineering and AI/ML — where I design distributed architectures that are not merely powerful, but genuinely intelligent.

From training deep learning models with PyTorch to orchestrating containerised workloads on Kubernetes, I thrive in environments that demand both theoretical depth and hands-on execution. I build production-grade ML pipelines and distributed services using Go and gRPC, following the 12-Factor App methodology for cloud-native reliability.

Before diving into systems design, I proved my analytical foundations by qualifying the NSES (Science Olympiad), IOQP (Physics Olympiad), and cracking JEE Advanced — a testament to structured, first-principles thinking.

When I step away from the terminal, you will find me on the dance floor or grinding through a calisthenics session — because discipline in movement mirrors discipline in architecture.
